verdict.rationale: Poke's API sits on a versioned path (/api/v1/...), and its docs record one concrete deprecation, the legacy inbound-sms webhook endpoint, with a migration path to V2 API keys. That is a single dated deprecation notice, not a published deprecation policy. The API is also a single endpoint. Missing for 10: a published deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, a stability or versioning commitment, a machine-readable spec (openapi.json returns 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Poke's API is a single documented endpoint on a versioned path (POST https://poke.com/api/v1/inbound/api-message, bearer auth)
the legacy inbound-sms webhook endpoint "is deprecated"
